exec: pm.test("La solicitud no lleva cabecera de sesion",()=>pm.expect(pm.request.headers.has("X-Metabase-Session")).to.be.false);
pm.test("No entrega datos del dashboard",()=>{const t=pm.response.text();pm.expect(t).to.not.include("dashcards");pm.expect(t).to.not.include("QA - Dashboard Restringido");});
pm.test("No hay error interno (la respuesta no es 5xx)",()=>pm.expect(pm.response.code).to.be.below(500));
pm.test("El cuerpo no expone trazas internas",()=>pm.expect(pm.response.text()).to.not.match(/at (clojure|java|metabase).|Exception in/i));
